summary: Reviewed 2-commit diff (4bc3b14, 076bc38): closed-loop-participant skill, learnings filter, create-skill skill, and config changes. No critical findings. Two warnings about the learnings filter regex not matching the hand-written format in loop/learnings.md (degrades safely — over-inclusive, never under-inclusive). All 58 orchestrator tests pass. Symlinks resolve correctly. Config changes are consistent across all 6 non-orchestrator agents.

findings.issue: loadLearningsForStage regex /^- \[.+?→\s*(.+?)\]/ only matches Unicode arrow (→). The actual loop/learnings.md uses ASCII arrow (->) and bold markdown (- **[...]), so the filter never parses existing entries. They pass through unfiltered to all stages, defeating the token-cost-reduction goal for hand-written entries. Retro-generated entries (via formatQuestionBullet at line 214) do use the matching format, so filtering works for future auto-generated entries.
findings.fix: Either broaden the regex to match both arrow types and optional bold markers (/^- (?:\*\*)?\[.+?(?:→|->)\s*(.+?)\]/) or document that the filter only applies to retro-generated entries. Add a test that exercises the actual learnings.md format to document the pass-through behavior.

findings.issue: All three loadLearningsForStage tests use the retro-generated format (- [source → target]) but never exercise the hand-written format (- **[source -> target]) actually present in loop/learnings.md. The test suite asserts the filter works, but doesn't reveal that it's a no-op against existing data.
findings.fix: Add a test with the actual learnings.md format (bold markers, ASCII arrows, multi-line entries) that asserts the lines are included for all stages (documenting the pass-through behavior).

findings.issue: regression skill removed from software-engineer. The skill remains on verifier, reviewer, and qa-acceptance, so regressions are still caught downstream. This is a deliberate token-cost trade-off that may cause slightly more loop-back iterations when the engineer introduces a regression that the engineer's own checklist would have caught.
findings.fix: No action required. If loop-back frequency increases, consider restoring it.

findings.issue: Participant skill correctly includes handoffs.md, stages.md, and learning-loop.md via symlinks; correctly excludes orchestrator-only content (team.md, host.md, pack.md, profile.md). All symlinks resolve. gates.md is accessible via .claude/rules/ files and protocol.md injection.
Skill scaffold instructions are clear and complete. Enforces symlinks over copies, names the required YAML frontmatter fields, and includes the yarn sync + hygiene verification steps.

learnings.insight: loadLearningsForStage filter regex only matches the Unicode arrow (→) generated by formatQuestionBullet, not the ASCII arrow (->) used in hand-written entries. The filter degrades safely (over-inclusive) but is ineffective against existing data.
learnings.action: When updating the filter, broaden the regex or normalize arrows on read. Add a test with the actual learnings.md format.

learnings.insight: Reviewer pass completed in one iteration with 0 critical findings, 2 warnings, 3 info items. 58/58 orchestrator tests pass. Pack hygiene clean.
